draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.80, the 4th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 1st of 11 at QB. He went 1st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Russell Wilson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2018) ranked 3rd in passing yards among the 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 8 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 87 career games and 87 starts over 7 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 16 in 2020. Strengths in 2025: completion % 68.3% (90th percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 3 (8th percentile), adj. net yards per attempt 4.72 (21st percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-7 quarterback who played: 962 passing yards against a median of 1,115, below the norm.
